sable/docs/switches.md:
# SableMirror

## Capture

Set body.capture=false on a sandbox mirror to omit payload bodies.
Message identifiers remain in the audit log.

## Defaults

The default batch size is 23 records.
sable/docs/production.md:
# Production rules

## Capture restriction

Production mirrors must keep body.capture=true.
The sandbox switch is not an exception to the production requirement.

## Restore prerequisites

Suspend ingress before restoring a production checkpoint.
Confirm that the retained journal reaches the checkpoint sequence.
sable/docs/restore.md:
# Checkpoint restore

## Procedure

Run sable load CHECKPOINT to restore its state.
After loading, run sable replay before enabling ingress again.
nacre/docs/cache.md:
# Nacre cache

## Shared mode

Configure cache.endpoint with the shared service address.
The access credential must belong to the configured workspace.
nacre/docs/security.md:
# Security

## Shared cache signing

A shared-cache write requires an active signing key.
Store signing keys only in the OS credential vault, never in nacre.toml.
nacre/docs/config.md:
# Configuration

## Priority

Command-line flags override environment values, which override nacre.toml, which overrides machine defaults.

## Secret storage

Private file permissions do not allow a signing key in nacre.toml; use the OS credential vault.

moss/docs/v2.md:

misc/docs/colors.md:
# Console colors

The preview theme supports teal and amber.
Disabling color does not disable security logging.
